attempts.sql: WITH RECURSIVE target AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND qualname = 'Client._send_single_request'), edges AS (SELECT c.caller_symbol_id AS src, c.callee_symbol_id AS dst FROM code.calls c JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id WHERE c.call_kind = 'direct' AND c.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL AND s.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py'), reach(symbol_id) AS (SELECT src FROM edges JOIN target ON edges.dst = target.symbol_id UNION SELECT e.src FROM edges e JOIN reach r ON e.dst = r.symbol_id) SELECT DISTINCT r.symbol_id FROM reach r JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = r.symbol_id WHERE s.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM target) ORDER BY r.symbol_id
